name: Panpipes of the Shao (Tiêu Thiều Quản)
lore: Twenty-three pipes of pale bamboo bound in gold that has gone the colour of honey. Cơ Phượng Nghi (co_phuong_nghi) made it for Cửu Thiều Cung in 80. Ngô Thê Đồng found it in the palace ruins in 485 and told no one (C097), and gave it to Hoa Triêu Dương dying (C182). Legendary item tieu_thieu_quan; the pipes are Light, the only Light in the palace.
build_use: Not worn in fights. A soul piece for the head's Nine Shao method; its real use is the hook.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Fan of the Morning Sun (Triêu Dương Phiến)
lore: Nine ribs of wutong wood and a leaf of red feathers from the vent birds of Chúc Dung Khẩu. The founder made it for his heir the year he gave her the palace, and named it for her.
build_use: The head's offence: Fire damage and heavier plumage stacks.

name: Five-Colour Plumage Robe (Ngũ Thải Vũ Y)
lore: Sewn from feathers the wutong's birds shed on the ridge in the palace's first twenty years, one colour for each virtue the Sơn Hải Kinh writes on the phoenix. The founder wore it to the North Star Compact (C107).
build_use: The head's guard: health, Fire resistance, and a ward every time the plumage is spent.

name: Seal of the Wutong (Ngô Đồng Ấn)
lore: Cut from a dead branch of the great wutong on the ridge in 485. Every writ the palace sent its vassals carried it until 1162. When the court moved to the Fire Court, Vu Ngô Đồng would not let it go: the founder had said the seal stays with the tree.
build_use: Wood sustain and Wood stacks: the Wutong Court's piece.

name: Censer of the Ash Seat (Niết Tọa Hương Lô)
lore: A bronze censer that holds one ember from the mouth of Chúc Dung Khẩu. It has not gone out since Nhiếp Tẫn Sa lit it in 952. Every elder of the palace for two hundred years broke through with it beside them.
build_use: The grand elder's sustain and the palace's breakthrough aid.

name: Left Wing (Tả Dực Phiến)
lore: One of a pair made in 1100 for two Dao partners of the Hall of Righteousness. Sử Hoành Dực carries the left. The right was taken from Dụ Đan Huỳnh's body at Đan Sơn Mạch in 1154 (N-phuong_minh-10).
build_use: A war fan: Fire damage, crit, long burns.

name: Right Wing (Hữu Dực Phiến)
lore: Dụ Đan Huỳnh's fan, taken at Đan Sơn Mạch in 1154 by Thính Vũ's war elder Cố Dạ Lan (co_da_lan), who is said to keep it in the Tower as a trophy. Phượng Minh has asked for it at every truce talk since. The palace keeps another sect's sword in its own hall of spoils (bt-red-plum), and Sử Hoành Dực does not like to hear that said.
build_use: The pair's heavy fan: crit damage and leech.

build_use: The array keeper's piece: wards and Fire stacks inside her own lines.

name: Dawn-Call Pipe (Triêu Minh Tiêu)

arts.name: Dawn Call (Thần Khiếu)
arts.rule: A note on the pipe: a Light hit with an added Soul part of 30 %, counting as a song and a soul art. Every third cast lays Exposed for 3 s. Needs a Light variant in the root.
arts.notes: Gated by requires.root_has ['light'] per e10. Uses element '' with 100 % convert to light because fight.py to_build rejects element 'light' until light-element is added there.

lore: A plain bamboo flute from Thiều Âm Thị, the one Chúc Hiểu Nghi's brother played the morning the birds fell silent (A248). He left it behind when he was sent away.

notes: Carries signature attack art dawn-call (e10); art_speed_pct scoped to [soul] until [song] scope joins the Modifier vocabulary (b2; note fight.py/build_file_compiler.gd currently map scope [soul] to dtype soul rather than tag soul).
